"'''Music Mayhem / The Night Lights of Tenoo'''" is the second episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Three|third season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[December 8]], [[2025]].

==Official description==
''The [[Jedi]]'' save a concert. A camping trip goes awry.''<ref name="Music Mayhem / The Night Lights of Tenoo" />
